meta_description: Woodlands Landscapes in Southampton creates beautiful, low-maintenance gardens for homes across Hampshire. Expert design, planting, and maintenance. Call for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Transform your Southampton garden into a beautiful outdoor space. From planting to patios, we handle every detail with care.
services_subhead: Whether you need a full redesign or regular maintenance, we offer bespoke landscaping tailored to your home and budget.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts that suit your lifestyle and space. We create detailed plans, handle all permissions, and bring your vision to life.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of trees, shrubs, and perennials chosen for Hampshire's climate. Year-round colour and structure guaranteed.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Durable patios, decking, and pathways in natural stone or composite materials. Built to last and enhance your outdoor living.

services.title: Lawn Care & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular cutting, feeding, aeration, and seasonal treatments keep your lawn lush and healthy. Monthly or ad-hoc visits available.

services.title: Raised Beds & Vegetable Gardens
services.desc: Custom-built raised beds with soil preparation, perfect for growing your own vegetables and herbs with minimal fuss.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Full garden clearing, overgrowth removal, and waste disposal. We leave your plot ready for renovation or fresh planting.

about_pullquote: We build gardens people love to spend time in, season after season.
about_para_1: Woodlands Landscapes was founded in 2006 by third-generation gardener Stuart Winters. For nearly two decades, we've transformed over 800 gardens across Southampton and the New Forest, from modest terraces to sprawling country plots. Our reputation rests on attention to detail, reliability, and a genuine love of growing things.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen first, design second, and never oversell. Many return year after year for maintenance and seasonal work. We pride ourselves on honest pricing, punctuality, and leaving every garden better than we found it — backed by a care guarantee on all newly planted stock.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Stuart and his team completely redesigned our back garden last spring. They listened to what we wanted, kept costs reasonable, and the finish is brilliant. Shrubs have all taken really well. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Overgrown disaster of a garden after moving in. Woodlands came in, cleared everything, laid a lovely patio, and got new borders in. Six months on, it looks exactly as we hoped. They're tidy, professional, and very fair on price.
reviews.author: Emma W.

reviews.text: Been getting Stuart to do our lawn and borders for three years now. Consistent, reliable, knows exactly what he's doing. Always has good ideas and the garden's never looked better. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

address_sub: Serving Southampton, Totton, Netley Marsh, Hedge End, and the New Forest
emergency_banner_text: Need your garden sorted fast? We can usually schedule new projects within 10 days. Call now —
footer_description: Woodlands Landscapes creates stunning, sustainable gardens across Southampton and Hampshire. Expert design, planting, and maintenance with 18 years' experience.
